name: spit-attend
description: SPIT Attend - Smart Attendance Management System v2

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.seed: cd server && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,TUNNEL" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:5173"
scripts.dev:ssl: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "cd client && npm run dev:ssl"
